title: Tesla Robotaxi Rams Through Bollards in Austin
detail: A Tesla Robotaxi struck and drove through bollards in Austin, Texas — an incident occurring weeks after CEO Elon Musk publicly claimed the fleet had an 'impeccable' safety record. The crash raises fresh scrutiny over the autonomous vehicle program's safety protocols and public deployment readiness.
